why: Two ANN implementations, one reachable. The new `_ann_search` (234-257) is a verbatim copy of the `query_embedding` branch of `search` (lines 155-171, 199-200): the same `SET ivfflat.probes`, the same `embedding IS NOT NULL AND retracted_at IS NULL`, the same `ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector`, the same 50-row cap. After this commit nothing in src/ calls `search(query_embedding=...)` - the only `search` call site is the lexical one at context_provider.py:132 - so the older branch is dead API and the new method supersedes it. Delete `query_embedding` from `search` and `FactRepository.search` (interfaces.py:92, 97-100, 103, 107), make `search` lexical-only with `limit: int = 10` (drops `effective_limit` at 164-166 and the if/else at 168-178), and delete the four ANN tests it orphans (tests/memory/test_fact_repository.py:182-243). Net -81: repository.py -13, interfaces.py -6, tests -62. Keep `_ann_search`: it is the only path that returns the `similarity` the re-ranker needs.

Dead knob. `_ann_search` has one caller, and it passes the value that is already the default: `self._ann_search(query_embedding, limit=_ANN_CANDIDATE_LIMIT)` at line 230; no test calls the private method directly. Collapse the signature to `async def _ann_search(self, query_embedding: list[float]) -> list[tuple[Fact, float]]:` and drop the keyword at the call site - `LIMIT $2` keeps binding the module constant inside the method. -3 lines, and one less way to request a pool size the re-ranker was not designed for.

The 5-line epoch-seconds helper exists only to compare against a 24-hour window, and `now = datetime.now(UTC).timestamp()` is `time.time()` spelled the long way. Use a timedelta instead: `_RECENCY_WINDOW = timedelta(hours=24)` (replaces `_RECENCY_WINDOW_HOURS = 24.0` and the `* 3600` at 282), normalize with `created_at = fact.created_at if fact.created_at.tzinfo else fact.created_at.replace(tzinfo=UTC)`, compare `now - created_at <= _RECENCY_WINDOW`, and delete `_utc_timestamp` (47-51). -4 lines plus one import, and the naive-datetime case stays witnessed by test_recent_fact_outranks_old_fact_at_equal_similarity.
